title: Selected Work
subtitle: Craft in production, design systems that ship as engineering infrastructure, and AI-native design–engineering — selected for HelloFresh

bio.short: I'm Tobias Treppmann, a design leader in Berlin. Fifteen years across four Head- and Director-of-design tenures, most recently at Bibel TV, where the design system ships as a live token API across Web, iOS, Android and Figma, and where the color engine that themes every card in the catalog is one I built and shipped in production. I lead through the work rather than around it, and I've been running an AI-native design–engineering practice long enough to have opinions about what breaks.
bio.long:
I'm Tobias Treppmann, a design leader in Berlin. Fifteen-plus years leading design at product-first companies — Bibel TV, ChurchDesk, Ninox, Datameer — with hiring, coaching and performance calls made across design and writing. I lead through the work, not around it.

At Bibel TV the design system ships as an API: Style Dictionary in a Git repo, three-tier tokens (primitives → semantic → component), automated sync across Web, iOS, Android and Figma. The color engine that themes every card in the catalog is one I built in OKLCH with WCAG contrast validation, live in production — the off-the-shelf palette extractor made half the artwork disappear, so design kept the thresholds and the tokens rather than delegating to a generic library. Prototypes are generated with agentic coding and engineering consumes the prototype code directly. At ChurchDesk I reframed a funeral-booking feature into a booking capability wired deep into the platform, shipped to twenty-plus cemeteries in two months on a €20k budget, and cut coordination from days of phone-tag to hours. At Ninox I ran a team of five designers plus a design lead, hired one designer and one writer, let go one of each, and coached the design lead through a difficult engineering-lead partnership — including redesigning the team's collaboration system so a sidelined engineer could actually participate.

What I care about is that the design decisions inside the pipeline stay with design — the color thresholds, the token architecture, the interaction agency the user actually gets when AI writes the first draft. I'm plain-spoken, comfortable moving without a map, and I've been shipping consumer-facing work in production, in Berlin, from the same office you'd hire me into.

context.company: HelloFresh Group / HelloTech — Consumer UX team inside the Consumer mega alliance. Eight brands, sixteen markets, 6M+ subscribers. Berlin HQ.
context.role: Director UX Design — a leadership role in a matrixed alliance alongside peer Directors, not solo design lead. Owns hiring, coaching and developing designers from IC through managers; owns execution across a product line at consumer scale; is expected to be a design-technologist and to have a POV on AI-native design.
context.emphasis: Lead with leading through the work, AI-native practice and design-engineering credibility. Foreground craft shipped in production — the color engine and the design system as an API — then bias to ship at product-line scale with the ChurchDesk booking numbers, then the peer-among-functional-heads years at Datameer, then hiring, performance calls and coaching design leads at Ninox. Berlin base, German native, English C2, EU work rights.
